question: Which is the minimal incompatibility between the candidate H/TX->native mesh model and the released total pathloss, once a linear-power versus dB interpolation difference is treated correctly?
source: Pinned Sionna RT1.1.0 MeshRadioMap.add sums squared ray fields with positive solid-angle/area/cosine factors per receiver triangle. Only one TX and one iso V antenna element. Direct samples before any physical ground interaction are seed independent. True per-cell total cannot be below its direct subtotal at identical samples. Published interpolation and MC domain/order undocumented in the complete original export script.
new_control: Reuse all 60 preselected C93 input-only terrains and 117 contiguous >=65m windows; nominal 4B launch lattice; original Sionna direct-only CPU replay at same geometry. Save native direct values for the exact donor triangle IDs/weights, not only the mixed raster. Preserve zero-direct cells as infinite loss bounds. Full initial C93 cap expansion already checked.
bounds: Compute three maximum-permissible total PL bounds from the exact native direct subtotal: linear power then -10log10; linear native PL interpolation if every donor positive; and the worst (largest) native donor PL, valid for any convex interpolation in either domain. Report Y>b+3,5,10 unconditionally on geometry-only clear VALID points, not only jointly-missed sites. All-positive donors are an explicit subset. Quantify Jensen gaps and interval. If labels exceed even the weakest donor's direct-power loss, the same-node monotone export cannot explain it. This is a contradiction among candidate geometry/TX/map/export assumptions; not evidence of negative real power or a global information-theoretic floor.
positive: Demonstrate interpolation noncommutation with two synthetic positive powers, and inspect core solver event sums plus primary-seed independence directly from pinned source. Pick a dual-band counterexample with all direct donor values positive and at least5dB beyond worst bound, typical among qualified violations by median severity, not presented as a population estimate.
resources: CC only, CPU-only; no new network training, no fusion search, no official VAL target use.
